snippet.title: over the hill - Algeria Biome & Playtest Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about over the hill: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2929250 

over the hill is an off-road exploration game about the quiet thrill of getting lost together. Drive vintage 4x4s through vast open environments inspired by real-world wilderness. There are no racing lines and no podiums here. Instead, it's about choosing your own route, reading the terrain, and figuring out how to reach the next lookout when the road disappears. 

Traverse rivers, climb steep rock faces, and winch your friends out of impossible situations in drop-in co-op. Every vehicle handles differently, every surface reacts to weight and momentum, and every journey becomes a small story you create together. The latest trailer reveals 'Algeria', one of the game's regions, a sun-baked landscape of sweeping plateaus, ancient ruins, sand-swept valleys, and even fallen meteorites waiting to be discovered. 

Unlock new vehicles, customize your setup, and venture deeper into the unknown. Whether you're scouting alone at sunset or tackling harsh conditions with friends, over the hill is about exploration, freedom, and the joy of the drive. Want to experience it for yourself? Sign up now for the closed playtest running April 24–26 on Steam. Registrations are open until April 16!


Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
